senses.gloss: m. (צְרב) mark of a burn, scab; צ׳ מרבנן one that has caught fire by associating with Rabbis (cmp.
units: Ab. II, 10); a student of rabbinical lore.
<cite ref="Megillah 28b:11">Meg. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אי צ׳ מר׳ הוא וכ׳</he> if he is a rabbinical scholar, let him recite a Halakhah, contrad. fr. <he>תנא</he> one who knows Mishnah.
<cite ref="Taanit 4a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>האי צ׳ מר׳ דרתח וכ׳</he> if a young student is hot (of temper), it is the learning that heats him.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:6">Keth. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא צ׳ מר׳ דמרחמין וכ׳</he> if a student is popular …; it is not because he is superior to others, but because he does not reprove the people &c.
